description: Infrastructure and roads damage assessment of Deir Ez Zor, Deir Ez Zor Governorate, Syria is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). This map illustrates satellite-detected damage to infrastructure and roads in a portion of the city of Deir Ez Zor, Syrian Arab Republic and is derived from a full UNOSAT analysis of damage to Deir Ez Zor in 2017. Coverage: Syrian Arab Republic. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are complex emergency-conflict-security, damage assessment, education, education facilities-schools, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEODATABASE, SHP. The portal shows 2025-08-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike (CC BY-SA). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
